Class AppleScrollBar.AppleMotion

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.AppleScrollBar.AppleMotion
Enclosing class:
AppleScrollBar
private static final class AppleScrollBar.AppleMotion extends Object
The AppleMotion fades the bars while the pointer is over one component. A scroll pane shares one fade across both bars. A parent-laid bar stores the single bar on the fade. The timer fires every sixteen milliseconds.

  • Constructor Details

    • AppleMotion

      private AppleMotion(JComponent host, JScrollBar stripBar)
      The constructor stores the component and the optional single bar. A null bar is stored as null. The timer delay is sixteen milliseconds. The timer repeats. The timer coalesces queued events. Each tick calls tick().
      Parameters:
      host - The component the pointer is tested against.
      stripBar - The single parent-laid bar, or null for a scroll pane.

  • Method Details

    • watch

      private static void watch(JScrollPane pane)
      The watch method starts a fade for both bars of a scroll pane. The stored bar is null. arm() records the fade on the pane.
      Parameters:
      pane - The scroll pane.

    • watchStrip

      private static void watchStrip(JComponent host, JScrollBar bar)
      The watchStrip method starts a fade for one parent-laid bar. A component that already stores an AppleMotion returns immediately. Any other component gets a new fade that remembers the bar. arm() records that fade.
      Parameters:
      host - The component the pointer is tested against.
      bar - The single bar.

    • arm

      private void arm()
      The arm method records this fade and listens for show changes. The client property casserole.apple.motion stores this object. A show or hide event calls setInside(boolean) from the current pointer. The component is added to the weak list. AppleScrollBar.ensureEar() installs the shared pointer listener.

    • forget

      private static void forget(JScrollPane pane)
      The forget method stops the fade for a scroll pane. A stored AppleMotion has its timer stopped. The motion property is cleared. The weak list drops a cleared reference. The weak list also drops this pane. An empty list removes the shared pointer listener and clears it.
      Parameters:
      pane - The scroll pane that is losing the overlay.

    • setInside

      private void setInside(boolean over)
      The setInside method stores whether the pointer is over the component. An unchanged value returns immediately. A changed value is stored. wake() starts the timer.
      Parameters:
      over - True when the pointer is over the component.

    • wake

      private void wake()
      The wake method starts the timer when it is stopped. A running timer is left alone. A start records the current time in nanoseconds before the timer starts.

    • tick

      private void tick()
      The tick method advances one frame of the fade. The elapsed time is the nanosecond gap divided by one billion. A negative gap becomes zero. A gap above five hundredths of a second becomes five hundredths. AppleScrollBar.step(float, boolean, float) moves the inside amount toward the inside flag. A single stored bar is advanced with tickOne(JScrollBar, float). A scroll pane advances the vertical bar and the horizontal bar. A component that is neither a single bar nor a scroll pane advances only the inside amount. The timer stops when the inside amount and every advanced bar have reached their ends.

    • tickOne

      private boolean tickOne(JScrollBar bar, float dt)
      The tickOne method advances one bar and repaints it. An AppleScrollBar.AppleBarUi receives AppleScrollBar.AppleBarUi.tick(float). A missing painter skips that call. A non-null bar is repainted. The return is true when the painter is still moving.
      Parameters:
      bar - The bar to advance. A null bar returns false.
      dt - The elapsed time, in seconds.
      Returns:
      True while that bar's thickness is still changing.

    • easedInside

      private float easedInside()
      The easedInside method returns the cubic-out amount for the pointer-over fade. The value comes from AppleScrollBar.eased(float, boolean).
      Returns:
      The eased amount from zero to one.
